purpose: Behaviour adopted by a frozen experiment, which every later phase must inherit. A later benchmark run that does not set these is measuring an older agent than the one that exists, and its numbers are not comparable to anything.

tool_argument_validation.why: inspect_schema silently ignored unknown arguments and returned a plausible-looking wrong response, so the agent looped without any way to detect it. The P1 ablation later showed the accuracy effect is not distinguishable from run-to-run noise, but the mechanism is real and measurable (5.6x malformed calls with it off), so it stays on.
tool_argument_validation.verdict: kept on mechanism grounds, not on a measured accuracy benefit

empty_result_policy.why: A valid query returning zero rows read as failure, so agents discarded queries they had already verified as correct. Labelling execution outcomes explicitly converted the frozen 39-task cohort from 19.23% to 71.79%, 29 tasks converted against 1 regression, with MAX_STEPS falling 44-52 to 9-11.
empty_result_policy.verdict: ADOPT, under the pre-registered rule in docs/P2_PREREGISTRATION.md

applies_to: every phase after the one that adopted it
every baseline, control, and treatment run of a later phase

explicitly_not_adopted.equivalent_query_detection: not built. If pursued, equivalence is defined as persisted result-set identity first, normalized SQL text as fallback. No semantic SQL-equivalence claim.
explicitly_not_adopted.final_answer_selection: not built. Targets FOUND_PASSING_SUBMITTED_WORSE (60 of 139 recoverable occurrences, dominant in 14 of 39 cohort tasks). Needs its own isolated experiment; mixing it with a termination-policy change would make neither attributable.
explicitly_not_adopted.loop_detection: not built. Deliberately excluded from the P2 experiment to keep attribution clean.

carry_forward_rule: A later phase's baseline is only a baseline if it runs with every flag above set to its adopted value. Benchmarking a later phase against pre-adoption behaviour would measure a regression this project already fixed and report it as the state of the art.
